overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board approved its January 8 open session minutes on February 12, within the 30-day timely-approval window, and its good-faith effort at the February 5 meeting was sufficient.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board failed to timely approve its January 8 open session minutes, approving them 35 days after the meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Here, the Board met five times after the January 8 meeting without approving the minutes, but those meetings were all held within 30 days; therefore, 30 days was the later of the two time periods in which the Board had to approve the minutes in a timely manner.
